comparison.objective: Tie, tension, and release an overhand knot; candidate configures a rigid gripper mechanism.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-cord loop formation and threading versus concentric screw/nut manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Knot survives suspended tension and five-second release versus locked opening survives three actuations.
comparison.reason: Both verify retention, but knot formation and mechanical stop locking are different abilities.
